about.text: A cheese said to be Yemeni, its name from the Arabic word for colostrum, eaten mostly in rural communities. Milk is boiled in a tannour with shathab, nigella seeds and salt, with smoked ghee added during cooking; in cities, eggs and milk are used instead.

sources.text: Its name, its boiling in a tannour with shathab, nigella, salt and smoked ghee, and the egg-and-milk version. The article carries maintenance tags, so it is said to be.
